text:
Japan’s inflation-adjusted, PPP GDP per capita rose by a factor of about 12 from 1950 to 2016 (roughly $1,900 to the mid-$20,000s in 1990 international dollars). Among the choices, that is a 10-fold increase (B). A 1950 level near $8,000 is far too high for the historical series.

CONFIDENCE: 70
